node.title: Zone-(b): e1 value-set collisions, 80<N'<512 (= perfiber at sigma=1)
node.statement: On an admissible clean-anchor row in the pair-feasible class |F_p(Q)|>=b_pair_min(K,B*), determine the exact ambient image of e1 on characteristic-zero antipodal-rearrangement classes and prove it exceeds B*. At the current clean predecessors the actual quotient orders are N=256 for rates 1/4,1/8 and N=512 for rate 1/16; folded dimensions are 128,128,256. Conditional on e1_fullness this supplies a route-local direct-value payload, not universal unsafe coverage.
node.attack_surface: prove the exact pointwise collision-pair allowance, certify the image directly, or replace E1 on the row
node.falsifier: a candidate-class row whose exact ambient E1 image is at most B*, or a purported certificate that confuses quotient order, folded dimension, or ambient field
